attacks.name: Crescent Glow
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. If you go second and it's your first turn, instead search for up to 3 Psychic Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Photon Laser
attacks.text: If you have at least 5 Energy in play, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Psylaser
attacks.text: Discard all Psychic Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

power.name: Cruel Charge
power.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Psychic Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.

power.name: Pumpkin Pit
power.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Stadium in play.

attacks.name: Shadow Mist
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Special Energy or Stadium cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Astral Barrage
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 5 damage counters on each of them.

attacks.name: Max Geist
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Psychic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

power.name: Underworld Door
power.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Psychic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Psychic Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Air Balloon
cards.text: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is ColorlessColorless less. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Boss's Orders
cards.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Evolution Incense
cards.text: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Fog Crystal
cards.text: Search your deck for a Psychic Energy card or a Basic Psychic Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Great Ball
cards.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Marnie
cards.text: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 4 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Ordinary Rod
cards.text:
Choose 1 or both:
• Shuffle up to 2 Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck.
• Shuffle up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Professor's Research
cards.text: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Quick Ball
cards.text: You can play this card only if you discard another card from your hand. Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Switch
cards.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Training Court
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may put a basic Energy card from their discard pile into their hand. This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
